comparison.objective: Drive a curved needle through two pad slots and transfer it between hands.
comparison.physical_skill: Curvature-following insertion, tissue-respecting rotation and bimanual needle handoff.
comparison.success_condition: Needle traverses both slots without tearing or dropping, receiving hand holds it, driving hand releases, stable for 1 s. No material rubric detail missing.
comparison.reason: Tests constrained curved insertion and handoff rather than collective particle dynamics through apertures.
